Vulnerabilities.Title: zlib: heap-based buffer over-read or buffer overflow in inflate
Vulnerabilities.Description: zlib through 1.2.12 has a heap-based buffer over-read or buffer overflow in inflate.

Vulnerabilities.Title: busybox: remote attackers may execute arbitrary code in netstat
Vulnerabilities.Description: BusyBox through 1.35.0 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code if netstat is used.
